records.question: How do I apply for the KOSPIE scholarship?
records.gold: Through the DAAD scholarship database, which also gives the application details.

Steps (DAAD portal):
- Register in the DAAD portal and then use the online application form to enter your data. [S2]

- Submit the application online in the DAAD portal. [S2]

Documents you must prepare to upload include (among others): personal identification document, CV (tabular, max. 3 pages), a statement/motivation letter (1–3 pages), baccalauréat, all university certificates with grades (and grading system explanation), proof of admission to an engineering programme (or cycle préparatoire if applicable), proof of English (not older than 2 years; e.g., TOEFL iBT/IELTS/etc.), the signed “Selection of host higher education institution” form, a recent supporting letter of recommendation, and German/English translations if documents are in your national language. [S1][S3]
